theme: Managed perf ports and Skia m151
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and ports several hot color and text paths to allocation-free managed code.
highlights_body: Colour conversion, premultiply math, and HarfBuzzSharp buffer/tag parsing move to managed, zero/low-allocation implementations, alongside WASM .NET 11 support and a native resource-leak fix.

bullets.lead: Updated to Skia Chrome milestone m151
bullets.detail: Bundles the Skia m151 engine, plus several rounds of merged upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes and a restore of SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster regression.
SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks the underlying native resource.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11, builds emsdk with the new exnref exception handling, and adds a WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions.

SKColor <-> SKColorF conversion and premultiply math move to managed integer math, SKColor hex parsing is optimized with new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, and the unnecessary unsafe modifier is removed from GRContextOptions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia submodule cleanup, Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11, and the cross-backend golden-image test harness

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 updated the engine to Skia m151 and began the managed color/premultiply performance ports.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added the allocation-free HarfBuzzSharp buffer/tag parsing and zero-copy SKShaper glyph reads.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate added WASM .NET 11 support and the SKImage native resource-leak fix ahead of stable.

harfbuzz_summary: Makes HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding and removes a per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse.
